meta.title: Jessica Tan — Growth, Product & Transformation Executive
meta.description: Jessica Tan works with founders, CEOs and leadership teams to turn ambitious strategy into commercial growth — across strategy, product, technology and operations.

hero.headline: Turning ambitious strategy into commercial results.
hero.intro: I work with CEOs, leadership teams and founders to turn ambitious strategy into commercial growth. I deliver profit, product and transformation across high-growth start-ups, scale-ups and global organisations, including PE-backed businesses.

items.title: Growth and commercial strategy
items.body: Clarifying where to play, strengthening propositions and pricing, and converting opportunity into measurable revenue.

items.title: Product and technology transformation
items.body: Connecting customer needs, commercial priorities and execution to build products and operating models that create real enterprise value.

items.title: Organisational transformation and CEO advisory
items.body: Helping leaders align priorities, operating models and teams around consequential business objectives — and deliver through complexity.
Revenue and synergies delivered through M&A and post-merger integration across three acquisitions, within three years.
Commercial strategy mobilised with 60+ cross-functional stakeholders, and across 11 European markets.
After-sales contract uptake grown by redesigning the customer journey, commercial proposition and delivery model.
Improvement in workforce utilisation through operational redesign and dispatch optimisation.

experience.heading: Experience
experience.intro: More than 20 years across commercial growth, product, transformation, technology, operations and strategy in Australia, the UK, Germany and France. Experience in scale-up, start-up and private equity-backed environments.

venture.heading: Current venture
venture.body: Building a consumer product from zero to live beta, brand strategy through technical deployment. Available for select interim, fractional and project engagements in commercial leadership and transformation.

contact.heading: Let's discuss what you are trying to change.
contact.sub: For fractional leadership, advisory and selected consulting engagements.
